title: Calibrating subgrid parametrizations of single-column ocean models via simulation-based inference
abstract: arXiv:2609.13242v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Subgrid parametrizations of vertical mixing in ocean models depend on free coefficients that cannot be measured directly and must be calibrated against high-fidelity references such as large-eddy simulations (LES). Existing approaches return point estimates and leave the associated uncertainty unquantified, a limitation when the inverse problem is ill-posed or when distinct parameter configurations fit the data comparably well. Simulation-based inference (SBI) addresses exactly this: given a prior and access to the simulator, it approximates the full posterior over parameters without requiring a tractable likelihood, at a cost set by the number of simulator evaluations. We apply it to \texttt{tunax}, a JAX-based single-column ocean model, to calibrate the coefficients of its $k$--$\varepsilon$ closure. A blockwise PCA summary statistic compresses the simulator output along the depth axis while preserving its forcing--horizon--variable

translated_title: 基于模拟推断的单柱海洋模型次网格参数化校准
translated_abstract: 海洋模型中垂直混合的次网格参数化依赖于无法直接测量的自由系数，必须通过与高保真参考数据（如大涡模拟（LES））进行对比来校准。现有方法仅返回点估计且未量化相关的不确定性，当逆问题呈病态性或当不同参数配置对数据的拟合程度相近时，这一局限性尤为突出。基于模拟的推断（SBI）恰好解决了这一问题：在给定先验分布并可获得模拟器的情况下，它无需可处理的似然函数即可近似参数的完整后验分布，其计算成本由模拟器的评估次数决定。我们将其应用于基于 JAX 的单柱海洋模型 tunax，以校准其 k–ε 湍流闭合方案的系数。通过分块 PCA 汇总统计方法沿深度轴压缩模拟器输出，同时保留其强迫-时间范围-变量信息……
tldr: 该论文提出利用基于模拟的推断（SBI）方法校准单柱海洋模型 k–ε 闭合方案中的自由系数，突破了传统点估计方法的局限，能够量化参数后验分布的不确定性。
en_tdlr: This paper applies simulation-based inference (SBI) to calibrate the free coefficients of the k–ε closure in a single-column ocean model, overcoming the limitations of point-estimate approaches by quantifying the full posterior uncertainty of parameters.
